citations.quote: shares held in electronic form are deposited into the CCASS and registered under the name of CCASS nominee (i.e. HKSCC Nominees Limited)

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Shares held electronically in Hong Kong's CCASS are registered in the name of HKSCC Nominees Limited, not the investor, so the beneficial holder is not on the company's register and must act through intermediaries for corporate-event information and voting — the default holding form behind a brokerage account.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: HK CCASS: Electronic Shares Sit Under HKSCC Nominees
